attempts.summary: Established a file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23, no AIDE/tripwire package available in repos) using a custom BusyBox-compatible script at /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity.sh, backed by SHA-256 checksums and metadata (perms/owner/size/mtime) for all 277 files under /etc, stored in /var/lib/file-integrity/. Verified detection works by modifying /etc/motd and adding a new file — both were correctly flagged — then reverted and regenerated a clean baseline. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, rebooted node1 via `reboot`, polled until reconnection, and confirmed a new boot_id plus intact baseline files and a clean verify run post-restart.
